FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 516
Committee: Commerce and Small Business Sponsor: Representative Prince Chestnut
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/08/2025
House Bill 516 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Attorney
General and district attorneys by establishing a new unlawful deceptive trade practice, which
could be offset by civil penalties imposed if found in violation of the provisions of this bill.
